import json, os, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import verify

def run(req):
    env = dict(os.environ); env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']='/workspace/native'
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=json.dumps(req).encode(),
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, timeout=120)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(), p.stderr.decode()

def base(**kw):
    case = {"model":"cnn","class_values":[1,2,3,4,5,6,7],"stats":[1,1,75],"bucket":[1,1],
            "slots":[[0,1,0]],"flows":[[1,1,-1,2]],"groups":[],"windows":[]}
    case.update(kw)
    return {"version":3,"cases":[case]}

tests = []
# no windows at all
tests.append(('no windows', base()))
# slot with zero capacity
tests.append(('zero capacity slot', base(slots=[[0,0,0]], windows=[[0,0,0,1,1,0,1,[[0,0]]*9]])))
# window never eligible (expires < slot time)
tests.append(('ineligible window', base(slots=[[10,1,0]], windows=[[0,0,5,1,1,0,1,[[0,0]]*9]])))
# window fails the gate (draw >= threshold)
tests.append(('gate rejects', base(windows=[[0,0,0,1,1,65535,1,[[0,0]]*9]])))
# two flows, one with no windows -> coverage 0
c = base(flows=[[1,1,-1,2],[1,1,-1,3]], windows=[[0,0,0,1,1,0,1,[[0,0]]*9]])
tests.append(('flow without window', c))
# group with ceiling 0
c = base(groups=[[-1,0]], flows=[[1,1,0,2]], windows=[[0,0,0,1,1,0,1,[[0,0]]*9]])
tests.append(('group ceiling zero', c))
# tokens exhausted
c = base(bucket=[1,0], slots=[[0,1,0],[1,1,0]], windows=[[0,0,1,1,1,0,1,[[0,0]]*9],[0,0,1,1,1,0,1,[[0,0]]*9]])
tests.append(('no initial tokens', c))
# refill saturation
c = base(bucket=[2,2], slots=[[0,1,0],[1,1,5],[2,1,0]], windows=[[0,0,2,1,1,0,1,[[0,0]]*9]]*3)
tests.append(('refill saturation', c))

for name, req in tests:
    code, out, err = run(req)
    if code != 0:
        print('%-22s EXIT %d %s' % (name, code, err[:200])); continue
    resp = json.loads(out)
    problems = verify.check_case(req['cases'][0], resp['results'][0])
    r = resp['results'][0]
    print('%-22s ratio=%s util=%s age=%s assign=%s problems=%s' % (name, r['ratio'], r['utility'], r['age'], r['assignment'], problems))
PYEOF
